title: The Universal Event Calendar
titleTail: : Every Seasonal Event at Both Resorts, Year at a Glance
h1: The Universal event calendar: every seasonal event at both resorts, month by month
description: A year-at-a-glance timeline of every recurring seasonal event at Universal Orlando and Universal Studios Hollywood, with each band labelled by confidence.
summary: The five detailed event guides on this calendar include confirmed 2026 Halloween Horror Nights dates on both coasts and confirmed Orlando holiday dates. Other event windows remain estimates until their own 2026 schedules are announced.
notes: Bands show whole months for orientation, not individual event nights. The 2026 Halloween Horror Nights ranges are confirmed, but each runs on select nights only; use the official event calendars to choose a date.

Two bands wrap the year. The holiday overlays at both resorts start in November and finish in the first days of January, encoded here as month 11 to month 1 rather than clamped to December, because clamping them would hide the reason the first days of January are worth knowing about.
This calendar details five recurring guides, not every limited-time event. Universal also publishes shorter seasonal programs; check each resort’s official events page for the current full lineup.

The two Halloween Horror Nights bands require separate event admission. Mardi Gras and the holiday park overlays are included with regular park admission; optional holiday tours or other add-ons may cost extra.

Confirmed 2026 bands: Halloween Horror Nights Orlando (August 28–November 1), Halloween Horror Nights Hollywood (September 3–November 1), and Orlando Holidays (November 14–January 3, 2027). The Hollywood holiday window remains unconfirmed.
